method: Exact source table and section comparison; rendered diagrams independently inspected for fastener callouts, assembly stacks, interfaces and routing. Prior-year ordered workflow is editorial scaffold only. All72 instruction/verification strings checked for stale source/value references. Remaining conflicts are explicit, not resolved by transferred values.

adaptations.detail: ECU and coil remain bolted to aircase; identified couplers and plug cap detached before lifting retained assembly, contingent on actual clear access. Avoid conflicting ECU torque.
Gear sensor stays installed; disconnect coupler rather than disturbing sealed switch.
Starter motor and rigid covers stay installed; rubber terminal cover released and lead nut removed while holding motor-side nut.
Exact check-bolt torque/seal document required before beginning and recorded after final level. No generic10Nm inferred.
